query: SELECT COALESCE(sum(octet_length(frame->'event'->>'text')) FILTER (WHERE frame->'event'->>'type' = 'reasoning.delta'), 0)::bigint AS "thinking!", COALESCE(sum(octet_length(frame->'event'->>'text')) FILTER (WHERE frame->'event'->>'type' = 'text.delta'), 0)::bigint AS "text!", COALESCE(bool_or(frame->'event'->>'type' = 'step.completed'), false) AS "completed!" FROM events WHERE conversation_id = $1 AND seq > $2 AND run_id = $3 AND frame->'event'->>'type' IN ('reasoning.delta', 'text.delta', 'step.completed')
